Context: 7. Central Administrative Tribunal

9. Review provision.If the applicant and/or the respondent are not satisfied with the judgment, it is open to them to seek review of the judgment by filing a petition within thirty days of the communication of the order. Review petition would lie only when there is a glaring omission, patent mistake or grave error in the judgment. It will be disposed of by the same Bench either by circulation or after hearing the parties.
